answer: An agent marketplace requires every seller identity to lock a $1,000 bond for 90 days before bidding on jobs, whether compiling an atlas or matching a pigment. Creating another account cannot reuse a locked bond, so a ripple of 10,000 fake sellers requires $10 million tied up at once. This does not prove the sellers are distinct, but it makes a sybil flood consume capital and forgo interest for the full lock period.
